Maya (PM): Heads-up: NovaSearch asked for a Dedicated launch candidate to run a new attention kernel. They need predictable 99p latency and no quality regression. Sketching acceptance criteria — want ENG eyes on feasibility.

Tony (Eng-RT): What are the numbers? kernel switch could regress throughput if kv cache behavior changes.

Maya (PM): Acceptance criteria (proposed):
```
- P99 text-gen latency <= 220ms on their 4k seq workload (measured end-to-end)
- Token generation quality: eval score delta <= 1.5% on NovaSearch prompt set
- No increase in error rate > 0.1%
- Fallback path triggers under overload with < 5% failed requests
- Canary rollout plan and automated regression alerting in console
```

Sophia (ML): 1.5% eval delta is tight but doable. Need the exact eval harness and golden prompts. Also which quant/precision for the kernel? Flash-attn optimized for fp16 but quantized kernels differ.

Tony (Eng-RT): Proposed plan: build a canary binary that enables new attention kernel + keep KV eviction unchanged, run local synthetic load, then 0.5% real traffic for 4 hours with tracing.

Li (SRE): Add SLO checks: streaming tail latency, error budget burn rate, and kernel-specific mem spikes. We'll auto-roll back if P99 increases by >20% vs baseline.

Jordan (ProductOps): NovaSearch expects a monthly SLA; can't accept regressions. They also asked for deterministic tokenization between kernels — is that even guaranteed?

Tony (Eng-RT): Tokenization not kernel-dependent, but subtle floating differences can change sampling. We'll add deterministic seeding and compare logits on golden set.

Sophia (ML): Edge case: long-prefix reuse + kv cache reuse can interact badly with attention tiling. Need tests for prefix-heavy workloads and streaming with early-stop.

Maya (PM): Ok action items:
- Eng: produce canary plan + test harness by EOD Thu (Tony)
- ML: provide golden prompt set + regression thresholds (Sophia)
- SRE: add auto-rollback hooks and dashboards (Li)
- ProductOps: confirm NovaSearch acceptable canary window and risk (Jordan)

Tony (Eng-RT): One more Q: kernel selection during runtime — do we route by model or by request length? I'd prefer model-level pinning initially.

Li (SRE): Model-level pinning is simpler operationally. We'll add a routing policy that prefers the new kernel for compatible models and falls back to 'stable' for mismatches.

Maya (PM): If no objections, I'll log PRD spike and schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow. :calendar: 

Jordan (ProductOps): confirm — NovaSearch ok with 0.5% canary + 24h monitoring? I'll check and loop back.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: env=daily, release=canary-attn-2026-03-21, %traffic=0.5

Tony (Eng-RT): good. I'll post the canary checklist in the PR.

Maya (PM): Thanks everyone — keep replies in-thread for the sync notes.
